arxiv-1811-10031.title: Analyzing Turing’s Systems via Dynamic Bifurcation Theory
arxiv-1811-10031.creator: Xige Yang, Dapeng Li
arxiv-1811-10031.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to study reaction diffusion systems – dynamic transition theory approach developed in [ 13 ] . This approach generalizes Turing’s classical result (linear stability analysis) on pattern formation and cast some new insights into Turing’s systems.

arxiv-1911-04736.creator: J.B. Climent, J.P. Berger, J. C. Guirado, J.M. Marcaide, I. Martí-Vidal, A. Mérand, E. Tognelli, M. Wittkowski

arxiv-2105-10292.title: Minimization and Synthesis of the Tail in Sequential Compositions of Mealy machines
arxiv-2105-10292.creator: Alberto Larrauri, Roderick Bloem
arxiv-2105-10292.description: Abstract We consider a system consisting of a sequential composition of Mealy machines, called head and tail. We study two problems related to these systems. In the first problem, models of both head and tail components are available, and the aim is to obtain a replacement for the tail with the minimum number of states.

arxiv-2303-06224.title: Finite Elasticity of the Vertex Model and its Role in Rigidity of Curved Cellular Tissues.
arxiv-2303-06224.creator: Arthur Hernandez, Michael F. Staddon, Michael Moshe, M. Cristina Marchetti
arxiv-2303-06224.description: Abstract Using a mean field approach and simulation, we study the non-linear mechanical response of the vertex model (VM) of biological tissue under compression and dilation. The VM is known to exhibit a transition between rigid and fluid-like, or floppy, states driven by geometric incompatibility.

arxiv-2305-10232.title: Panchromatic simulated galaxy observations from the NIHAO project
arxiv-2305-10232.creator: Nicholas Faucher, Michael R. Blanton, Andrea V. Macciò
arxiv-2305-10232.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nicholas Faucher, Michael R. Blanton, Andrea V. Macciò. We present simulated galaxy spectral energy distributions (SEDs) from the far ultraviolet through the far infrared, created using hydrodynamic simulations and radiative transfer calculations, suitable for the validation of SED modeling techniques. SED modeling is an essential tool for inferring star formation histories from nearby galaxy observations, but is fraught with difficulty due to our incomplete understanding of stellar populations, chemical enrichment processes, and the non-linear, geometry dependent effects of dust on our observations.

arxiv-2401-10558.title: ICBeLLM: High Quality International Events Data with Open Source Large Language Models on Consumer Hardware
arxiv-2401-10558.creator: Rex W. Douglass
arxiv-2401-10558.description: Abstract The International Crises Behavior Events (ICBe) ontology provides high coverage over the thoughts, communications, and actions that constitute international relations. A major disadvantage of that level of detail is that it requires large human capital costs to apply it manually to new texts.

arxiv-2407-00377.title: The Factuality Tax of Diversity-Intervened Text-to-Image Generation: Benchmark and Fact-Augmented Intervention
arxiv-2407-00377.creator: Yixin Wan, Di Wu, Haoran Wang, Kai-Wei Chang
arxiv-2407-00377.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yixin Wan, Di Wu, Haoran Wang, Kai-Wei Chang. Prompt-based “diversity interventions” are commonly adopted to improve the diversity of Text-to-Image (T2I) models depicting individuals with various racial or gender traits. However, will this strategy result in nonfactual demographic distribution, especially when generating real historical figures. In this work, we propose DemOgraphic FActualIty Representation (DoFaiR) , a benchmark to systematically quantify the trade-off between using diversity interventions and preserving demographic factuality in T2I models.

arxiv-2504-12646.title: Replication Packages in Software Engineering Secondary Studies: A Systematic Mapping Journal: Information and Software Technology
arxiv-2504-12646.creator: Aleksi Huotala, Miikka Kuutila, Mika Mäntylä
arxiv-2504-12646.description: Abstract Context: Systematic reviews (SRs) summarize state-of-the-art evidence in science, including software engineering (SE). Objective: Our objective is to evaluate how SRs report replication packages and to provide a comprehensive list of these packages. Method: We examined 528 secondary studies published between 2013 and 2023 to analyze the availability and reporting of replication packages.

pmc-11662236.title: Prospective Association of the Mediterranean Diet with the Onset of Cardiometabolic Multimorbidity in a UK-Based Cohort: The EPIC-Norfolk Study
pmc-11662236.creator: Qiaoye Wang, Amand Floriaan Schmidt, S Goya Wannamethee
pmc-11662236.description: BackgroundCardiometabolic multimorbidity (CMM), defined as the co-occurrence of 2 or more cardiometabolic diseases, including myocardial infarction (MI), stroke, and type 2 diabetes (T2D), is an increasing public health challenge. Although poor diet is a known risk factor for a first cardiometabolic disease (FCMD), the relationship with subsequent occurrence of CMM is less studied.

pmc-11693261.title: FEASIBILITY, ACCEPTABILITY, AND UTILITY OF THE HOME ALONE INTERVENTION: A PRELIMINARY MIXED METHODS EVALUATION
pmc-11693261.creator: Grace Savard, Robyn Birkeland, Stephanie Ingvalson, Renèe Pepin, Jill Cigliana, Laura Gitlin, Joseph Gaugler
pmc-11693261.description: Research has established that living alone with cognitive impairment in later life presents an increased risk for social isolation, decline in mobility, and other adverse health outcomes. While the number of older adults living independently with cognitive impairment is expected to increase, few programs are available to address the specific needs of this growing population.

pmc-11713266.title: Local disruptions in non‐rapid eye movement sleep expression are associated with cerebrovascular pathology and worse memory performance in older adults
pmc-11713266.creator: Destiny E Berisha, Batool Rizvi, Miranda G Chappel‐Farley, Abhishek Dave, Novelle J Meza, Negin Sattari, Kitty K Lui, Ivy Y Chen, Nicholas J Tustison, Ariel Neikrug, Ruth M Benca, Michael A Yassa, Bryce A Mander
pmc-11713266.description: BackgroundAging is associated with disruptions in non‐rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep and memory decline. Cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) increases with age and is associated with clinical sleep disturbance, but little is known about its relationship with local expression of NREM sleep.

pmc-12642211.title: The impact of AI integration in project preparation in education course on pre-service teachers’ innovativeness, AI anxiety, attitudes, and acceptance
pmc-12642211.creator: Mustafa Sat
pmc-12642211.description: The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in education has transformed teacher education programs. This study examined the effects of incorporating AI tools into a Project Preparation in Education course for pre-service teachers, focusing on individual innovativeness, AI anxiety, AI attitudes, and AI acceptance.

pmc-12652346.title: A Plot Twist: When RNA Yields Unexpected Findings in Paired DNA-RNA Germline Genetic Testing
pmc-12652346.creator: Heather Zimmermann, Terra Brannan, Colin Young, Jesus Ramirez Castano, Carolyn Horton, Alexandra Richardson, Bhuvan Molparia, Marcy E. Richardson
pmc-12652346.description: Background: Germline genetic variants impacting splicing are a frequent cause of disease. The clinical interpretation of such variants is challenging for many reasons including the immense complexity of splicing mechanisms. While recent advances in splicing algorithms have improved the accuracy of splice prediction, predicting the nature and abundance of aberrant splicing remains challenging.

pmc-12788140.title: Specific Dynamic Parameters: A Novel Multi-View Stereo Vision Measurement System for Vector Nozzle
pmc-12788140.creator: Zhixiao Lin, Kechen Song, Han Zhang, Zhenbo Zhou, Yansong Zhang, Chenggang Li, Yunhui Yan
pmc-12788140.description: As a crucial component of aero-engines, the accurate measurement of the motion parameters of the vector nozzle is of great significance for thrust vector control and flight performance improvement. This paper designs a dual-bearing rotating nozzle to simulate the motion of a real vector nozzle and a multi-view vision platform specifically for measuring the motion parameters of the vector nozzle.

pmc-13194937.description: We have engineered, fabricated, and qualified ZAPPI (Zonal Atmospheric Pressure Plasma Ionizer), an array of hollow electrical discharge emitter micro needles for volatile organic compound ionization and detection. The device is optimized for portable applications requiring low power and trace analyte abundance. The 250 µm interelectrode gap requires just 1.

pmc-13386622.title: Exploring the impact of melatonin on cancer-related fatigue: a dose-response meta-analysis with GRADE evidence evaluation
pmc-13386622.creator: Sajjad Etesamnia, Mahdiyar Nasiraie-Moghadam, Pariya Mostafazadeh, Mohammad-Reza Jowshan, Kamran Roudini, Seyed Rohollah Miri, Alireza Jahan-Mihan, Alireza Haghighi, Soraiya Ebrahimpour-Koujan
pmc-13386622.description: BackgroundCancer-related fatigue (CRF) is a prevalent and debilitating symptom among patients undergoing cancer treatment, yet its management remains a clinical challenge. Previous studies evaluating the role of melatonin in CRF have yielded inconsistent findings. This meta-analysis aimed to assess the overall effect of melatonin supplementation on fatigue and to explore potential dose–response relationships.

pmc-13486599.title: Single-cell multiomics identifies an ALDH9A1–carnitine signaling axis driving resistance of NSCLC to immunotherapy
pmc-13486599.creator: Hailei Du, Tong Lang, Xiaoxue Zha, Chao Qu, Ling Chen, Shihua Yao, Xing Feng, Zhaohui Jin
pmc-13486599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SignificanceAlthough immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have revolutionized the clinical management of non–small cell lung cancers (NSCLCs), majority of patients ultimately develop primary or acquired resistance, limiting long-term therapeutic benefits. Here, we show that ALDH9A1, the committed enzyme in carnitine biosynthesis, is a previously unrecognized regulator of immune evasion in NSCLC and an important functional contributor to immunosuppressive remodeling and response to anti-PD-1 therapy. This resistance can be overcome by IL-1β neutralization or pharmacologic ALDH9A1 inhibition with DEAB.

pmc-13563049.title: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia Secondary to Protein C Deficiency: A Case Report
pmc-13563049.creator: Moeez Ahmad Saeed, Asad Ullah Khan, Aniqa Iqbal, Muhammad Usman Mehmood, Ahmed Ayyan, Hashim Mohamed Siraj, Wasfa Shafiq, Ali Gohar, Muhammad Husnain Ahmad
pmc-13563049.description: A 43‐year‐old hypertensive male presented with severe abdominal pain, nausea, and constipation due to Protein C deficiency with lupus anticoagulant. CT angiography revealed thrombotic occlusion of mesenteric arteries with collateral circulation. Conservative management with dual anticoagulation and parenteral nutrition achieved clinical improvement without surgery, highlighting thrombophilia's role in mesenteric ischemia.
